description:
Configure the Maven project 'csv-stats' to produce an executable JAR file that bundles all dependencies (specifically Apache Commons CSV). 

1. Modify 'pom.xml' to add the 'maven-shade-plugin' (for bundling dependencies) and 'maven-jar-plugin' (to specify the Main-Class).
2. The Main-Class is 'com.csvstats.App'.
3. Run the Maven 'package' goal.
4. Verify the resulting JAR at 'target/csv-stats-1.0.jar' is executable and runs correctly with: 'java -jar target/csv-stats-1.0.jar src/main/resources/sample_data.csv'.

The project is located at ~/IdeaProjects/csv-stats.
